question: How many tracks are in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM "Track"

question: What are all the music genres?
sql: SELECT "Name" FROM "Genre" ORDER BY "Name"

question: How many albums are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM "Album"

question: What media types are available?
sql: SELECT "Name" FROM "MediaType" ORDER BY "Name"

question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM "Customer"

question: List all playlist names
sql: SELECT "Name" FROM "Playlist" ORDER BY "Name"

question: How many employees does the company have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM "Employee"

question: What is the unit price of the most expensive track?
sql: SELECT MAX("UnitPrice") AS max_price FROM "Track"

question: Which albums did AC/DC release?
sql: SELECT al."Title" FROM "Album" al JOIN "Artist" ar ON al."ArtistId" = ar."ArtistId" WHERE ar."Name" = 'AC/DC' ORDER BY al."Title"

question: List all tracks in the Rock genre
sql: SELECT t."Name" FROM "Track" t JOIN "Genre" g ON t."GenreId" = g."GenreId" WHERE g."Name" = 'Rock' ORDER BY t."Name"

question: What tracks are in the Music playlist?
sql: SELECT t."Name" FROM "Track" t JOIN "PlaylistTrack" pt ON t."TrackId" = pt."TrackId" JOIN "Playlist" p ON pt."PlaylistId" = p."PlaylistId" WHERE p."Name" = 'Music' ORDER BY t."Name"

question: Show each track name with its media type
sql: SELECT t."Name" AS track, m."Name" AS media_type FROM "Track" t JOIN "MediaType" m ON t."MediaTypeId" = m."MediaTypeId" ORDER BY t."Name"

question: List each customer's first name, last name, and their support representative's last name
sql: SELECT c."FirstName", c."LastName", e."LastName" AS rep_last_name FROM "Customer" c JOIN "Employee" e ON c."SupportRepId" = e."EmployeeId" ORDER BY c."LastName", c."FirstName"

question: What albums does Metallica have?
sql: SELECT al."Title" FROM "Album" al JOIN "Artist" ar ON al."ArtistId" = ar."ArtistId" WHERE ar."Name" = 'Metallica' ORDER BY al."Title"

question: Show each track name and the genre it belongs to
sql: SELECT t."Name" AS track, g."Name" AS genre FROM "Track" t JOIN "Genre" g ON t."GenreId" = g."GenreId" ORDER BY t."Name"

question: How many tracks does each genre have?
sql: SELECT g."Name" AS genre, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM "Track" t JOIN "Genre" g ON t."GenreId" = g."GenreId" GROUP BY g."Name" ORDER BY track_count DESC, g."Name"

question: Which artist has the most albums?
sql: SELECT ar."Name", COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM "Album" al JOIN "Artist" ar ON al."ArtistId" = ar."ArtistId" GROUP BY ar."ArtistId", ar."Name" ORDER BY album_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average track length in milliseconds?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG("Milliseconds")) AS avg_ms FROM "Track"

question: How many customers are there per country?
sql: SELECT "Country", COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM "Customer" GROUP BY "Country" ORDER BY customer_count DESC, "Country"

question: What is the total revenue from all invoices?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM("Total")::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue FROM "Invoice"

question: What is the average invoice total?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG("Total")::numeric, 2) AS avg_total FROM "Invoice"

question: Which albums have more than 15 tracks? Show album title and track count.
sql: SELECT al."Title", COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM "Track" t JOIN "Album" al ON t."AlbumId" = al."AlbumId" GROUP BY al."AlbumId", al."Title" HAVING COUNT(*) > 15 ORDER BY track_count DESC, al."Title"

question: How many invoices were issued per billing country?
sql: SELECT "BillingCountry", COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM "Invoice" GROUP BY "BillingCountry" ORDER BY invoice_count DESC, "BillingCountry"

question: What are the top 5 best-selling tracks by total quantity sold?
sql: SELECT t."Name", SUM(il."Quantity") AS total_sold FROM "InvoiceLine" il JOIN "Track" t ON il."TrackId" = t."TrackId" GROUP BY t."TrackId", t."Name" ORDER BY total_sold DESC, t."Name" LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 customers have spent the most in total?
sql: SELECT c."FirstName", c."LastName", ROUND(SUM(i."Total")::numeric, 2) AS total_spent FROM "Invoice" i JOIN "Customer" c ON i."CustomerId" = c."CustomerId" GROUP BY c."CustomerId", c."FirstName", c."LastName" ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the total revenue per genre?
sql: SELECT g."Name" AS genre, ROUND(SUM(il."UnitPrice" * il."Quantity")::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM "InvoiceLine" il JOIN "Track" t ON il."TrackId" = t."TrackId" JOIN "Genre" g ON t."GenreId" = g."GenreId" GROUP BY g."GenreId", g."Name" ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Which country generates the most invoice revenue?
sql: SELECT "BillingCountry", ROUND(SUM("Total")::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM "Invoice" GROUP BY "BillingCountry" ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 5 best-selling albums by total tracks sold?
sql: SELECT al."Title", SUM(il."Quantity") AS total_sold FROM "InvoiceLine" il JOIN "Track" t ON il."TrackId" = t."TrackId" JOIN "Album" al ON t."AlbumId" = al."AlbumId" GROUP BY al."AlbumId", al."Title" ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which employee supports the most customers?
sql: SELECT e."FirstName", e."LastName", COUNT(c."CustomerId") AS customer_count FROM "Employee" e JOIN "Customer" c ON c."SupportRepId" = e."EmployeeId" GROUP BY e."EmployeeId", e."FirstName", e."LastName" ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total revenue per media type?
sql: SELECT m."Name" AS media_type, ROUND(SUM(il."UnitPrice" * il."Quantity")::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM "InvoiceLine" il JOIN "Track" t ON il."TrackId" = t."TrackId" JOIN "MediaType" m ON t."MediaTypeId" = m."MediaTypeId" GROUP BY m."MediaTypeId", m."Name" ORDER BY revenue DESC
